The structure of Eu2Mg3Fe6O16, with reduced formula EuMg3(FeO2)6, crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4_2/mnm (No. 143) with 27 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe, Eu, and Mg centers each coordinated by six oxygen neighbors, while O centers have four geometric neighbors. The Fe-centered 4-vertex polyhedra share corners and edges with one another, and corner- and edge-sharing is also observed between Eu- and Fe-centered polyhedra. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 27 sites.
